checks.message: Configure a public HTTPS origin without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.
Authentication must use the same public HTTPS origin as the store.
Provide a private strong authentication secret of at least 48 characters.
If configured, the order-token secret must be strong and at least 32 characters.
Remove the administrator bootstrap password from the running environment.
Hosted environments require permanent S3-compatible storage.
Configure the S3 region, bucket, and private write credentials.
Configure a public HTTPS media base URL without embedded credentials, query, or fragment.
Hosted previews must explicitly set COMMERCIAL_LAUNCH_APPROVED=false.
Hosted previews must explicitly set ALLOW_INDEXING=false.
The configured database must be reachable and its application schema readable.
Create a private administrator with a password account.
Configure the original official logo using its bundled asset or permanent HTTPS media.
Checkout must remain disabled in the preview database.
Delivery to Gaza must remain disabled.
Only approved delivery regions may be enabled.
Approved delivery zones require a valid nonnegative server-side fee.

notices.message: The returns policy is awaiting owner review; preview does not approve or publish it.
The privacy policy is awaiting owner review; preview does not approve or publish it.
The terms policy is awaiting owner review; preview does not approve or publish it.
Products still need original product photographs.
Product names still need owner confirmation.

limitations: Configuration and read-only database checks do not test public reachability, HTTPS certificates, media access, backup restoration, or real-device behavior.
Passing preview checks does not publish draft content or authorize commercial launch.
